title.law: complete at frame 0, two lines max, no wrap at fontPx, mid-screen above the head, no card, gone by ~2.1 s; caption font

stack.grammar: formats/creator-format-1-hook.md: ALL CAPS, 1-2 words per line, connectors small white, mid line 1.45x accent, one hero fit to ~64% width in terracotta; punch line as its own stack; every hero >= 600 ms
stack.stackTopFrac: geometry.suggest.stackTopFrac (format.json owns it, never a literal in code)

firstObject.law: a card or float up inside 0.5 s that is not the title; the punch stack owns the screen alone

speed: 1x everywhere. No ramp, no atempo, ever (2026-09-05, "don't sped up pls. Don't do that"); pacing comes from the cut preset.
